Markets.title: Global Market: Emerging Asian currencies rise as softer dollar, rate-hike bets support sentiment
Markets.summary: Emerging Asian currencies strengthened modestly due to a weaker US dollar and fading expectations of a September Federal Reserve rate hike. However, rising oil prices and broader risk aversion capped these gains and caused Asian equities to weaken.

Markets.title: US Stock Market |  Fed policy may be accommodative under medium-term neutral rate estimate: Reports
Markets.summary: A San Francisco Fed research paper indicates that U.S. monetary policy could be more accommodative than widely believed when compared to medium-term neutral interest rate estimates. This finding introduces new perspectives to the ongoing debate among Federal Reserve officials, despite existing uncertainties surrounding neutral-rate calculations.

Markets.title: Tube Investments of India shares surge 8% after Q1 earnings. What Motilal Oswal is saying
Markets.summary: Tube Investments of India shares surged 8% after the company reported a 5% drop in Q1 profit to Rs 158.62 crore despite a 17.7% increase in revenue. Motilal Oswal maintained its Buy rating with a Rs 3,379 target, driven by strong core performance and double-digit export growth.

Markets.title: Welspun Living shares surge 8%; stock gains 14% in 3 days. What’s driving the rally?
Markets.summary: Welspun Living shares surged nearly 8% on Tuesday, bringing its three-day gain to about 14% following a strong Q1FY27 financial report. Brokerages Motilal Oswal and JM Financial maintained buy ratings on the stock, citing improving fundamentals and margin expansion.

Markets.title: Global Market: Trump-backed World Liberty partners with platform offering Chinese AI models
Markets.summary: Trump-backed crypto project World Liberty Financial has partnered with Hong Kong-based WorldClaw, a platform providing access to Chinese AI models. This collaboration faces scrutiny due to US security restrictions on Chinese developers and the Trump family's financial stake in World Liberty.

Markets.title: Biocon shares rise 2% after USFDA approval for Yesintek single-dose prefilled autoinjector
Markets.summary: Biocon shares rose 2% after the US Food and Drug Administration approved its Yesintek single-dose prefilled autoinjector in two strengths. This approval expands the company's US immunology portfolio with a treatment for conditions such as plaque psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, Crohn's disease, and ulcerative colitis.

Geo-Political.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: IVF staff in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents by using unselected sperm and egg donors. As a result, multiple children are feared to have been conceived using the wrong donors.

Geo-Political.title: Russia says UK 'will pay' for supplying drones to Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: Russia warned that the UK will face consequences for supplying drones to Ukraine. In response, a British Ministry of Defense spokesperson stated that the UK stands firmly with Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
Geo-Political.summary: An officer testified that after Tupac Shakur was shot multiple times, the rapper refused to cooperate with police. Shakur instead told the officer that he and his associates would handle the situation themselves.

Geo-Political.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
Geo-Political.summary: German authorities conducted their first raids under a new anti-smuggling law, seizing dinghies and life jackets from a secret warehouse. The operation targeted criminal gangs facilitating illegal migration using small boats.

Geo-Political.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
Geo-Political.summary: China is censoring public mourning during the funeral of former premier Li Keqiang. Authorities fear that public nostalgia for Li could turn into criticism of President Xi Jinping's administration.

Geo-Political.title: Student killed in Philippines Catholic school shooting
Geo-Political.summary: A student was killed in a shooting at a Catholic school in the Philippines. The alleged shooter, who was also a student, subsequently died by suicide.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the Southwest Monsoon's overall rainfall deficit has narrowed to 13%, the season is marked by extreme regional imbalances. Erratic weather patterns are causing severe fluctuations between intense deluges and prolonged dry spells across different areas.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the removal of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) securing government contracts. Currently, MSMEs awarded orders exceeding ₹100,000 must provide a guarantee worth 3% to 10% of the project value.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS). While joblessness increased in urban areas, it declined in rural regions.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Indian consumers are spending again. Can it last?
Data & Insights.summary: Indian consumer spending grew in the first quarter, driven by rural demand, premium products, and quick commerce. However, higher input costs and food inflation threaten to derail this ongoing recovery.

Data & Insights.title: Currency in circulation, ATM withdrawals, 10 countries, hinterland India… How UPI made a dent in the financial universe
Data & Insights.summary: India's UPI transaction value has surged to equal 70% of the country's total currency in circulation. This rapid growth is driven by widespread adoption extending far beyond major economic hubs into hinterland regions.

Data & Insights.title: India’s $20 trillion economy by 2036: The 5 growth engines that could unlock its next leap
Data & Insights.summary: An Equirus policy report states that India can reach a $20 trillion economy by 2036. This growth will be driven by five key areas: human capital, markets, services, governance, and currency.

India.title: 'Was Used For Criminals': Delhi Cops On Face Cameras At Jantar Mantar
India.summary: Delhi police stated that over 240 personnel sustained injuries during the Cockroach Janta Party's 'Chalo Sansad' march on July 20. Authorities also defended the use of face cameras at Jantar Mantar, stating the technology was deployed to monitor criminals.

India.title: "Thinks Can Justify Such Vulgarity": DMK On Vijay, Trisha Salute At Independence Day Event
India.summary: The DMK criticized actors Vijay and Trisha in its mouthpiece, Murasoli, for exchanging salutes and for Vijay's seating arrangement during an official Independence Day event. The party questioned how anyone could justify such vulgarity at a public program.

India.title: "Less Painful" Lethal Injection For Death Penalty? Supreme Court Says No
India.summary: The Supreme Court of India rejected a petition seeking to replace hanging with lethal injection as a less painful method of execution. However, the court stated that the government can form an expert committee to review alternative methods of the death penalty.

India.title: 103-Year-Old Assam Woman Donates Lifelong Savings To Flood-Hit Families
India.summary: A 103-year-old woman from Assam donated her entire lifelong savings to support families affected by severe floods. Deputy Commissioner Mridul Yadav accepted the contribution and publicly thanked her for her generosity.

India.title: Rs 1.20-Crore Testicle Myth: How A Reel Led To A Teen's Murder In Bhopal
India.summary: Police in Bhopal solved the murder of a teenager—triggered by a social media reel about a Rs 1.20-crore testicle myth—after circulating his photographs and conducting door-to-door inquiries. Authorities used these investigative methods to establish the victim's identity and uncover the bizarre motive behind the crime.

India.title: Minister's "Italian Blood" Attack On Sonia Gandhi, Congress Hits Back
India.summary: The BJP accused Sonia Gandhi of objecting to the singing of the full version of 'Vande Mataram' at a party Independence Day event. The Congress party strongly hit back at the criticism regarding her Italian heritage.
